trajectory.patch:
The root cause of the numerous compilation errors is an issue with the `DT_COMPAT_GET_ANY_STATUS_OKAY` macro in `include/zephyr/devicetree.h`. This macro was returning a node identifier wrapped in parentheses. When this result was used as an argument to other devicetree macros that perform token pasting (like `DT_PROP`, `DT_FOREACH_CHILD`, etc.), the parentheses would break the token pasting mechanism, leading to "pasting ')' and ..." errors and a cascade of other compilation failures.

The fix is to remove the parentheses from the `then` and `else` arguments within the `COND_CODE_1` macro used in the definition of `DT_COMPAT_GET_ANY_STATUS_OKAY`. This ensures that it expands to a bare node identifier token, which can be correctly processed by other devicetree macros.

<include/zephyr/devicetree.h>
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
#define DT_COMPAT_GET_ANY_STATUS_OKAY(compat)			\
	COND_CODE_1(DT_HAS_COMPAT_STATUS_OKAY(compat),	\
		    (DT_INST(0, compat)),		\
		    (DT_INVALID_NODE))
========
#define DT_COMPAT_GET_ANY_STATUS_OKAY(compat)			\
	COND_CODE_1(DT_HAS_COMPAT_STATUS_OKAY(compat),	\
		    DT_INST(0, compat),		\
		    DT_INVALID_NODE)
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
